videos.title: NO HELP COMING! Cowboys STAND PAT at Trade Deadline | DLLS Cowboys After Dark with Jeff Cavanaugh
videos.summary_source_text:
NO HELP COMING! Cowboys STAND PAT at Trade Deadline | DLLS Cowboys After Dark with Jeff Cavanaugh The NFL Trade Deadline has come and gone, and Jerry Jones and the Dallas Cowboys DID NOTHING!

Despite the Cowboys fighting to stay alive in the NFC playoff race, Dallas stood pat at the trade deadline. That means Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, Quinnen

Williams and the rest of this roster are the players the Cowboys will have to rely on to make a postseason push.

But is this team actually GOOD ENOUGH?

On tonight’s DLLS Cowboys After Dark, Jeff Cavanaugh breaks down the Cowboys’ decision to stand pat, what it means for the rest of the season and whether Brian Schottenheimer can get enough out of this roster to make a serious run at the playoffs. videos.title: Flytta vikten med klubban…
videos.channel: Bättre & Enklare golf med Marcus Edblad PGA
videos.summary_source_text:
Flytta vikten med klubban… Forcera inte fram viktförflyttningen utan lita på och låt kroppen naturligt fltta vikten i samspel med hur vi rör klubban.

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro - Flytta vikten naturligt. 
1:00 Regelbundenhet är nyckeln till framgång. 

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

Träna styrketräning för hela kroppen för att må bra genom livet och skapa en effektiv maskin. Träna händer, handleder och armar för att skapa en effektiv release och mer svinghastighet.

Du kan finna inspiration i filmer som Happy Gilmore, Tin Cup eller Bagger Vance. Filmer som Rocky kan ge dig motivation att ta dig till gymet. Legender som Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone eller Hulk Hogan kan få dig att vilja bli starkare och Moe Norman, Arnold Palmer, Ben Hogan, Sam Snead eller Jack Nicklaus kan inspirera dig att bli en bättre golfare. 

Ge aldrig upp i sökandet och träningen för att få bästa bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår.

Filmat med iPhone 18 och redigerat i iMovie på en Macbook Neo. Forcera inte fram viktförflyttningen utan lita på och låt kroppen naturligt fltta vikten i samspel med hur vi rör klubban.

Does Size Matter? 7.4L V8-swap E30 v BMW M2 DRAG RACE Are drift cars able to perform in a straight-line drag race?! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-28-10

It’s time for a BMW head-to-head… With a difference! 

We’ve got Mat in the stock BMW M2, and he’s lining up against an E30 BMW 3 Series. 

But this is no ordinary BMW 3 Series! It’s a Red Bull drift car with a huge engine under the bonnet, and on paper it looks like it could seriously push the BMW M2 all the way! So let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the M2, it’s powered by a 3-litre twin-turbo straight-six that can produce 480hp and 600Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels only via an 8-speed auto gearbox, and it tips the scales at 1,754kg. In terms of cost, it’s valued at £71,645. 

Then we come to the E30. The original engine has been ripped out, and it’s now packing a colossal Chevy 7.4-litre V8! This produces 630hp and 800Nm, with all this power sent to the rear wheels via a 5-speed sequential gearbox. As much as possible has been stripped out of the car to make it as light as possible, so you can guarantee it weighs a whole lot less than the M2! 

But can a drift car really perform in a straight line? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

videos.summary_source_text:
11.11.26 - RIFT Training Day RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

videos.title: Post-NFL Trade Deadline Reactions + Broncos Bye Week Reflections | MoodSwings
videos.summary_source_text:
Post-NFL Trade Deadline Reactions + Broncos Bye Week Reflections | MoodSwings Welcome to 'The Morning Liv(e)' show with Liv Moods!

Whether it's on your way to work, while sipping a coffee in your living room, or however else you're spending your morning, if you're looking for a place to get all the latest NFL and NBA news, you're in the right place!

Liv breaks down and discusses the biggest takeaways from the NFL trade deadline, which came and went yesterday, November 10th. The Broncos shocked most fans and made a move right before the deadline, bringing in Chargers LB Daiyan Henley in exchange for a handful of future draft picks. Was this a solid move by Denver? Or did we want to see a bigger move from the front office?

Moving the conversation away from the Broncos, Liv also discusses some other important moves around the league that are worth keeping an eye on. Kirk Cousins LEAVES the AFC West and is heading back to the Minnesota Vikings, his former team, where he hopes to lead the current 6-2 Vikings through the remainder of the season in a gauntlet of an NFC North division, and maybe even make a deep playoff run.

Once the trade deadline officially concluded, a report surfaced that the New York Giants had called the Atlanta Falcons in an attempt to acquire Bijan Robinson before the deadline. Even though the trade didn't go through, you have to give the Giants a TON of credit for how aggressive they've been in making moves over the last year. When your QB goes down, most teams just accept their fate and ride with the backup. But the Giants went out and got JJ McCarthy, who has had a pretty solid campaign in New York so far, minus some injury complications. What would this move have looked like if Bijan DID go to the Giants?

If you're Jonathan Taylor, are you happy or frustrated that you didn't get moved at the deadline? There seemed to be a TON of buzz surrounding his status and whether or not he would be moved, specifically to the Denver Broncos. What does Taylor's future look like now that he'll finish the season with the Colts?

videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 11.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

videos.summary_source_text:
Bump, Turn, Bump, Turn” Move (Like Tiger 2000) Does your downswing feel like it’s all arms? Your weight shift might be a beat late.
Bump, turn. Bump, turn. That’s the rhythm to watch for in Tiger Woods’ 2000 swing. Here’s how I practice it with the Ball First Board.

Which BTW we have the loweeeest price on the Ball First Board right here!

https://improve.shotcraftgolf.com/products/bfb/lp2?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_content=youtube-short-BumpTurnTiger

1️⃣ Before the backswing, press into your trail foot, then turn. Keep the bump small enough that you don’t sway into the alignment stick.

2️⃣ Before your arms start down, feel a slight squat as you shift pressure into your lead foot. Then turn through and let your arms follow.

🔖 Save this golf swing drill for your next range session. Before you hit your first ball, make three slow practice swings and say “bump, turn, bump, turn” as you go.

videos.title: Put Your Finger in Your Ear for 30 Seconds—Your Brain Will Surprise You!  Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Put Your Finger in Your Ear for 30 Seconds—Your Brain Will Surprise You!  Dr. Mandell What happens when you put your finger in your ear for just 30 seconds? You may be surprised by the connection between your ears, brain, and nervous system! In this fascinating video, Dr. Alan Mandell reveals simple ear stimulation techniques that may help promote relaxation, ease everyday tension, and support your body's natural calming response. Discover how gentle pressure near the ear canal, tragus stimulation, massage behind the ears, and even humming interact with sensory pathways associated with the nervous system, including branches of the vagus nerve. Learn why these areas are so interesting, how breathing influences your body's relaxation response, and how you can experiment with these simple techniques in just 30 to 60 seconds. Everyone responds differently, but you might discover an easy way to unwind, quiet your mind, and feel more relaxed naturally. Try these gentle techniques for yourself, share this video with someone who could benefit, and let me know what you experience! Dr. Mandell, motivationaldoc.

videos.summary_source_text:
Matvei Michkov WANTS OUT of Philadelphia?! ft. Charlie O'Connor | The Sheet Does Matvei Michkov want OUT of Philadelphia? Jeff Marek and Greg Wyshynski are joined by Charlie O'Connor to break down Kevin Weekes' report that Michkov is looking for a fresh start away from the Philadelphia Flyers.

The report comes just days after a heated exchange between Michkov and Nick Seeler on the Flyers bench went viral, raising even more questions about Michkov's future in Philadelphia and what comes next for the organization.

Jeff and Greg also recap a wild night in Winnipeg, where Dawson Mercer scored twice to lead the Jets to a 4-2 victory over the New Jersey Devils. From the hostile chants directed at Connor Hellebuyck to the decision to keep him out of the lineup, there's plenty to unpack.

Plus, the Toronto Maple Leafs have lost four straight games on their homestand with the Minnesota Wild and Edmonton Oilers coming to town. The guys also discuss Jakob Chychrun's massive hit on Nick Cousins and the social media fallout, Minnesota's win over the Montreal Canadiens, and the NHL GMs exploring technological assistance for officials at their annual fall meetings.

All that and more on today's edition of The Sheet with Jeff Marek and Greg Wyshynski!

videos.title: Does Daiyan Henley make the Denver Broncos the favorites in the AFC? | DNVR Broncos Podcast Live
videos.summary_source_text:
Does Daiyan Henley make the Denver Broncos the favorites in the AFC? | DNVR Broncos Podcast Live Did the Denver Broncos do ENOUGH at the NFL trade deadline to make a Super Bowl run? Sean Payton and George Paton added Daiyan Henley from the Los Angeles Chargers, but how much better does he make Denver’s defense? Was the price right, and should the Broncos have done more to help Bo Nix and the offense?

The DNVR Broncos Podcast breaks down the Daiyan Henley trade, his fit alongside Alex Singleton and Justin Strnad, and what Denver’s deadline decisions tell us about the rest of the season. What should Broncos Country expect from Henley, and how do we grade the move?

Plus, we break down the biggest NFL trades, including Josh Downs to the Kansas City Chiefs, Amani Hooker to the Buffalo Bills, Jacksonville’s additions of Jordan Davis and Jessie Bates, and Kirk Cousins’ return to the Minnesota Vikings. Which teams improved the most, and what do those moves mean for Denver?

With the Broncos sitting at 7-2, leading the AFC West and holding the AFC’s No. 2 seed behind Buffalo, we examine the current AFC standings and the race for home-field advantage. Who poses the biggest threat to Denver, and what will it take to finish on top?

• Pris i Sverige: från 809 900 kr
• Effekt: 469 hk (345 kW) och 645 Nm
• 0–100 km/h: 4,9 sekunder
• Batteri: 108,7 kWh
• Räckvidd: upp till 828 km (WLTP)
• Snabbladdning: upp till 400 kW, 10–80 % på 21 minuter
• Bagage: 490–1 600 liter plus 58 liter under huven
• Dragvikt: 2 000 kg
• Cw-värde: 0,23
• M Sportpaket och panoramaglastak är standard

We also investigate a critical question: Are AI systems genuinely approaching human-level general intelligence, or are impressive benchmark results hiding major limitations?

- Sam Altman's 2026 AGI prediction

- OpenAI GPT-6 Astra vs Claude Fable 5.2
- Google Gemini 4 and the race for AI supremacy
- Anthropic's AI agents and scientific research claims

The AGI race is accelerating, but the evidence tells a more complicated story than the headlines suggest.

Topped shots and inconsistent contact from one day to the next usually come from standing up or lifting during the golf swing, and it's what Eric Cogorno sees every day in golf lessons with regular golfers. When your shoulders turn too level, your body moves farther from the ground, and constantly getting farther from and closer to the ground is the least consistent way to play. The fix is shoulder tilt: your left shoulder goes down and in and under your chin in the backswing, about 40°, and your right shoulder goes down with even more tilt, about 55°, in the golf downswing, the same pattern you see in Tommy Fleetwood's golf swing. These golf swing tips and a simple golf drill with a second ball about one yard outside the first show you how much tilt to feel, so you can build a consistent golf swing and learn how to hit irons solid. If you leave this video without trying this golf drill, you're leaving solid, consistent contact on the table.

What You'll Learn:
• Why standing up in your golf swing leads to topped shots
• How to move your left shoulder down and under your chin
• What the Tommy Fleetwood swing shows about left shoulder tilt
• A golf drill to find the right amount of shoulder tilt
• Why you need more tilt in the golf downswing than the backswing
• Golf tips to keep your height going back and get lower coming down
• Why you have to exaggerate a feel to make a real change
• High handicap golf tips from Eric's golf lessons for solid contact

They wrap things up with concerns surrounding the Denver Nuggets' slow start, potential changes to the roster and coaching staff, and the Colorado Avalanche's early-season performance.

Even after menopause, your ovaries continue to produce important hormones, including estrogen, progesterone, testosterone, and DHEA. A hysterectomy can affect blood flow to the ovaries and potentially disrupt hormone production even when the ovaries aren’t removed.

Unlike natural menopause, which happens gradually, hormonal changes after a hysterectomy can occur suddenly, giving the body less time to adapt.

Hysterectomy side effects may include:
• Hot flashes, night sweats, and poor sleep
• Mood changes and cognitive problems
• Bladder and bowel problems
• Increased cardiovascular risk
• Bone loss and osteoporosis
• Insulin resistance and visceral fat
• Muscle loss and joint pain

Hormonal changes after a hysterectomy may also affect nitric oxide production, inflammation, and long-term health.

To support your health and hormones after a hysterectomy, focus on intermittent fasting and a low-carb diet with high-quality animal protein.

videos.summary_source_text:
I Tried to Vibe Code Zapier (Claude Code) Try my exact Zap in Zapier (one click and Copilot builds it): https://mrc.fm/vibecode
The clone prompt from Can I Vibecode It: https://mrc.fm/vibecodeprompt

I gave Claude Code one prompt from Can I Vibecode It and it built me my own Zapier clone in about four and a half minutes, on a five dollar server. Webhooks, schedules, retries, a run log, alerts. Then I sent the same leads to my clone and to Zapier, and fast forwarded through six months of real life: logins that expire, a teammate renaming a tab, a server going down, a Node.js update, a full disk, and a month of security patches.

My clone failed again and again. Zapier kept every single lead.

Claude Code didn't write bad code. The problem is everything around the code. That's not building, that's maintaining, and maintaining never ends.

This video is sponsored by Zapier.

videos.summary_source_text:
GOING GLOBAL! The Carolina Hurricanes' First Couple of Days in Helsinki have been Finn-tastic The Carolina Hurricanes are officially in Helsinki, Finland, and are already enjoying a new culture. For some, it's their first time there. For others, they're returning for another experience. Then there are those who are returning to their home country to play an NHL game in front of those who supported them along the way. On the Wednesday Edition of Locked On Hurricanes, Zach begins the show by sharing his thoughts on what it means for Sebastian Aho, Jesperi Kotkaniemi, and Juuso Valimaki as they get to showcase their home country and culture to their teammates. What does it mean for these three Finnish players to be back home and play an NHL game in front of family and friends? Secondly, Zach shares his thoughts on the first practice lines from Helsinki at "The Cave". What makes sense, and what does he hope for when Game 1 of the Global Series rolls around? Finally, Zach wraps up the show by reacting to what Jordan Staal and Jordan Martinook said after Day 1 in Helsinki. How do they feel about the upcoming games and being in Finland? All of that and more, on the latest edition of Locked On Hurricanes.

videos.title: Bruno Senna: How Ayrton Inspires A New Generation | F1 Beyond The Grid Podcast
videos.summary_source_text:
Bruno Senna: How Ayrton Inspires A New Generation | F1 Beyond The Grid Podcast An icon of Formula 1, a three-time World Champion, and a hero even to those who never saw him race. More than three decades after his death, Ayrton Senna remains an inspiration for F1 drivers and fans all over the world.

Bruno Senna, Ayrton’s nephew and former F1 driver, tells Tom Clarkson about Kimi Antonelli’s recent trip to the Senna family farm, when the 2026 World Champion sat in one of Ayrton’s cars and drove on a go-kart track he designed.

Bruno tells the story of Ayrton’s famous victory at home in 1991, when he screamed in exhausted celebration after winning the Brazilian Grand Prix in a car stuck in sixth gear. He remembers how Ayrton taught him to fight on track – preparation for Bruno’s own F1 career with Hispania, Lotus and Williams in the early 2010s.

Bruno also explains the work of the Senna Foundation, which has helped to educate 30 million children in Brazil since it was founded, and hails today’s Brazilian F1 stars – Gabriel Bortoleto and Rafael Camara.

videos.title: Long Drive Challenge | 40-Year-Old Driver Edition
videos.summary_source_text:
Long Drive Challenge | 40-Year-Old Driver Edition How far can the world's best players hit 40-year-old  golf clubs? Featuring Rory McIlroy, Tommy Fleetwood and Jon Rahm.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

After 40 events, five global swings, the Back 9 and four Majors, the DP World Tour Play-Offs are upon us. The top 70 available players from the Race to Dubai Rankings Delivered by DP World tee it up this week at Yas Links before the top 50 then move on to the season-finale at the DP World Tour Championship. Both those events form part of the Rolex Series, with Patrick Reed, Tom Kim and JJ Spaun having already been crowned Rolex Series champions in 2026. With full playing privileges on the DP World Tour now secured the focus turns to the quest to be Europe’s Number One and claim the Harry Vardon Trophy. Rory McIlroy is looking to equal Colin Montgomerie's record of eight season-long wins with his fifth in a row but the Northern Irishman is in the unusual position of being the hunter rather than the hunted. Last year, Aaron Rai beat fellow Englishman Tommy Fleetwood in a play-off to win his second Rolex Series title at Yas Links, five years on from his first at the Scottish Open. The 70 player field is stacked with star-studded names, featuring 6 major winners including Rory McIlroy, Jon Rahm and Patrick Reed alongside three-time season winner Eugenio Chacarra who will be hoping to add a Rolex Series title to his CV. With enhanced points on offer it also means that the jostling for dual membership with the PGA Tour is far from over.

videos.title: 10.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
10.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

In 5 minutes! NO sugar! Protein brownie! Just a couple of ingredients! In 5 minutes! NO sugar! Protein brownie! Just a few ingredients! Simple, delicious, and quick. Cook with pleasure and good humor!

1 banana.
1 cup (250 g) cottage cheese. ½ cup (130 g) yogurt.
2 eggs. ¼ cup (50 g) almond flour.
¼ cup (25 g) unsweetened cocoa powder. 1 tbsp honey.
Peanut butter.
Bake in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 45 mins.
Let the cake cool completely.

Paul Maurice, Panthers Postgame: Florida Ends Slide, Wins in Columbus Florida Panthers coach Paul Maurice speaks to the media after his team beat the host Columbus Blue Jackets 4-1 on Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026. 

Sam Bennett scored twice with the Panthers ending a two-game slide. 

Lars Eller and Sam Reinhart also scored, with Reinhart passing Jonathan Huberdeau for second-most goals in franchise history. 

Jacob Markstrom made 36 saves.

The Panthers play host to Detroit on Thursday.

videos.title: Avalanche Avenge 6-3 Loss to Maple Leafs With a 6-3 Win In Toronto
videos.summary_source_text:
Avalanche Avenge 6-3 Loss to Maple Leafs With a 6-3 Win In Toronto Colorado Avalanche overpower the Toronto Maple Leafs with a commanding 6-3 victory, even with Nathan MacKinnon’s name missing from the scoresheet. Is Colorado’s offensive depth the key to another deep postseason run?

The conversation focused on the Avalanche’s balanced attack, standout plays from Devon Toews and Gabe Landeskog, and Nazem Kadri’s pinpoint passing in key moments. Analysis covered Toronto’s struggle to contain Colorado’s third line, detailed player stat breakdowns—including William Nylander’s invisible night—and the impact of Mackenzie Blackwood’s sharp goaltending. A key theme that emerged was how the Avs twice responded to Leafs’ surges, sealing the win with timely goals and relentless forechecking. The discussion explored lineup adjustments, strategic momentum shifts, and the implications of Denver’s growing confidence as playoff season nears.

Can the Maple Leafs bounce back from another home defeat, or is Colorado’s depth too much for contenders to handle?

Nick Turchiaro-Imagn Images

videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 10.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

Watch the FULL video here: https://youtu.be/MhUgmTCJyiE

🌟 Take Dr. Berg’s New Health Quiz—60 seconds is all it takes: https://drbrg.co/4BR1UsO

Iodine plays several important roles in the body, including:
• Supporting thyroid hormone production
• Helping regulate estrogen activity
• Supporting breast and reproductive health
• Strengthening immune function
• Reducing inflammation
• Supporting healthy brain development during pregnancy

Iodine intake has also been studied for its relationship to breast and prostate cancer risk. Getting enough iodine is especially important during pregnancy when deficiency can affect fetal development.

videos.summary_source_text:

The #1 Meal to Fight Artery Plaque and Keep Blood Flow Strong | Dr. Mandell Can one meal really help fight artery plaque and support healthy blood flow? In this video, Dr. Mandell explains how plaque develops inside artery walls and builds a practical heart-supporting meal with leafy greens, tomatoes, beans, salmon, and extra-virgin olive oil. You’ll learn how soluble fiber can help lower LDL cholesterol, why replacing some saturated fat with unsaturated fat matters, and how the Mediterranean-style eating pattern has been studied for cardiovascular health. No single meal can instantly wash away an existing blockage, but the choices you repeat can support healthier arteries over time. This meal is one practical place to start—along with regular movement and the medical care your health professional recommends.

videos.title: What Dementia Does to Your Brain?
videos.summary_source_text:
What Dementia Does to Your Brain? Walked into a room and forgot why? That on its own isn't dementia. In this calm, evidence-based guide you'll learn the difference between ordinary forgetfulness and the 8 warning signs that are worth a doctor's visit. You'll also learn the treatable "look-alikes": low vitamin B12, a slow thyroid, medicine side effects, delirium and depression. We cover how depression and anxiety show up in later life, clear up three common myths, and finish with six steps the research supports, from protecting your hearing to knowing your blood-pressure numbers.

- 4:18 Depression and anxiety

- 7:48 When to see a doctor
- 8:40 Recap

videos.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Preview Is Insane: It Just Beat Fable 5.2!
videos.summary_source_text:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Preview Is Insane: It Just Beat Fable 5.2! https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=infl-youtube--na-acq-web&ref=BitBiasedAI-sd25

GPT-6.2 has reportedly appeared inside OpenAI's own Codex usage dashboard, with one developer seeing the mysterious model name account for 37.7% of a day's usage. But OpenAI hasn't announced GPT-6.2, the model picker hasn't changed, and developers can't access it through the public API.

So what exactly is OpenAI testing? And could GPT-6.2 be the company's answer to Anthropic's newly launched Claude Fable 5.2?

The timing is hard to ignore. GPT-6.2 sightings began around November 1, just eight days before Anthropic launched Fable 5.2 on November 9. According to Anthropic's published benchmarks, Fable 5.2 scored 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0, compared with 42.8% for OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra. That's a 6.3-point advantage on a major coding evaluation.

The computer-use numbers are even more striking. On OSWorld 2.1, Anthropic reports Fable 5.2 reaching 89.3%, while GPT-6 Astra scores 79.5%.

But those results come from Anthropic's own testing, with important methodological limitations. And there's currently no independently verified GPT-6.2 benchmark to compare against them.

That's where the mystery begins.

Screenshots collected by TestingCatalog show a model labeled "gpt-6.2-astra" appearing in Codex analytics. Different users reportedly saw it accounting for 1.6%, 19.8%, and even 37.7% of their usage. Yet nobody could deliberately select GPT-6.2, and direct API requests reportedly returned model-not-found errors.

Could this be an internal canary deployment, an experimental routing system, or simply a backend label that doesn't represent a new model?

There's also a critical technical distinction most viral posts overlook: a model identifier appearing in a log isn't necessarily proof that a corresponding model actually processed the request. Some interfaces can echo arbitrary model names, making screenshots far less conclusive than they initially appear.

And the rumors don't stop with Astra.

Names including GPT-6.2 Sol, Bel, Beetlejuice, and Betelgeuse have circulated across Reddit, Discord, and social media. One anonymous claim even describes a model exceeding 10 trillion parameters. None of these claims currently has authenticated documentation or independently reproducible evidence.

Then came the viral demonstrations: a 360-degree 3D pelican riding a bicycle, a semi-open-world RPG supposedly generated from one prompt, browser automation experiments, and logic puzzles allegedly showing GPT-6.2 outperforming Claude.

Impressive? Potentially. Verified as GPT-6.2 outputs? Not yet.

We examine why these demonstrations don't establish model identity, why a single spectacular output isn't a meaningful benchmark, and what a legitimate head-to-head comparison would actually require.

Meanwhile, OpenAI's documented releases tell a different story. GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Luna, Terra, and GPT-6 Cyber show a strategy focused on faster inference, lower costs, specialized capabilities, and expanded context windows.

GPT-6.1 Terra reportedly delivers performance comparable to Astra at around one-tenth the price per token, while GPT-6 Cyber introduces a 1.05-million-token context window for security customers.

So is GPT-6.2 an imminent breakthrough, a quiet internal experiment, or an ordinary infrastructure label amplified into a major AI launch rumor?

And more importantly, what would OpenAI actually need to achieve to overtake Claude Fable 5.2?

We break down the leaked Codex evidence, Anthropic's benchmark claims, the questionable GPT-6.2 demonstrations, competing model releases, and the crucial difference between a possible test and a verified breakthrough.

Because until an official model card, accessible API, and reproducible benchmarks appear, the biggest GPT-6.2 claims remain exactly that: claims.

Provkörd: BYD Dolphin laddhybrid – smartare än ren elbil? Betalt samarbete Betalt samarbete med BYD. BYD har betalat för att jag skulle testa bilen och göra den här filmen. De har inte fått påverka innehållet och alla åsikter är mina egna – både ris och ros.

BYD lanserar nu en liten laddhybrid – Dolphin G DM-i – som lovar 10 mil på el och över 100 mil med full tank och fullt batteri. Men hur långt går den egentligen i verkligheten när man kör på motorväg och landsväg i höstkyla?

Jag nollställer mätarna vid Arlanda och sätter kurs mot Nacka och Gustavsberg för att sätta den på prov. I testet kollar vi: • Verklig räckvidd på ren eldrift • Vad bensinmotorn drar när elen tar slut • Köregenskaper, vägljud och komfort • Hur snabbladdningen fungerar i praktiken • Prisbild jämfört med små rena elbilar

videos.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Is Here — Is This Actually AGI?
videos.summary_source_text:
Claude Fable 5.2 Is Here — Is This Actually AGI? https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=infl-youtube--na-acq-web&ref=BitBiasedAI-sd25

Anthropic's new Claude Fable 5.2 reportedly formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in just 28.7 hours using 1,000 AI agents. It also allegedly built an operating system, designed working electronic devices, controlled robots, and solved advanced physics problems. But how much of this is independently verifiable, and how much is Anthropic's own marketing?

Announced on November 9 alongside the more restricted Claude Mythos 5.2, Fable 5.2 is being positioned as a specialist AI model for complex engineering, scientific research, coding, and large-scale autonomous workflows.

Its specifications are ambitious: a 1-million-token context window, 128,000-token maximum output, roughly 30% faster performance than its predecessor, and a fast mode that Anthropic says runs 2.5 times faster. Pricing starts at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

But the specifications aren't the biggest story. The evidence behind Anthropic's claims is.

One of the most remarkable demonstrations involved 1,000 AI agents collaborating to formalize Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean, a mathematical proof assistant that checks logical correctness. Anthropic reports completing the task roughly nine times faster than an earlier human-assisted Claude run. However, the agents received intermediate theorems and relied on a carefully engineered coordination system. That's a significant distinction from solving the problem independently from scratch.

Then there's the hardware experiment. Working with Diode, Fable 5.2 reportedly designed three functional electronic devices: a USB speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. Human engineers manufactured and assembled them, and Anthropic says all three worked without electrical modifications.

On PCB Gym, the model reportedly scored 69%, compared with 25% for an earlier Claude model. On BenchCAD, it reached 83.5%.

The robotics results are equally eye-catching. Fable 5.2 achieved a reported 64.9% on RoboDojo, compared with 29.8% for GPT-6 Astra and 27.6% for Fable 5.1. But RoboDojo is a simulation benchmark, not proof of reliable real-world robotic autonomy.

And that's where the launch gets more controversial.

Anthropic claims that Fable 5.2 coordinated more than 1,000 subagents over eight days to create a bootable prototype operating system, complete with drivers, persistent storage, a graphical interface, and an installer. Yet no publicly released OS image, source code, or independent reproduction currently supports the full claim.

We also examine two publicly available theoretical physics preprints, the reported virus-capsid modeling breakthrough involving Mythos 5.2, and customer testimonials claiming dramatic improvements in scientific computing, cybersecurity, and software migrations.

The benchmark comparisons raise another question: how much does reasoning effort affect the rankings?

Anthropic reports Fable 5.2 scoring 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 versus 42.8% for GPT-6 Astra, reaching 82.1% on WANDR, and achieving 74.2% on Humanity's Last Exam with tools. Some efficiency comparisons look particularly promising, but different effort settings and company-reported evaluations complicate the picture.

We break down what those numbers actually mean, how Fable 5.2 compares with Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon, and why running thousands of agents can be far more expensive than the advertised token pricing suggests.

The bigger question isn't whether Fable 5.2 is powerful. It's whether increasingly autonomous AI systems can deliver reliable results without independent verification.

Is Claude Fable 5.2 a genuine breakthrough in agentic AI, or are impressive demonstrations getting ahead of reproducible evidence?

Watch the full breakdown before deciding whether this model deserves a place in your development or research workflow.

Which Anthropic claim should be independently tested first: the operating system, robotics, hardware design, or mathematical proofs? Let us know in the comments.

videos.summary_source_text:
7 “Healthy” Foods That Destroy Your Metabolism Have you ever consumed something because you believed it was healthy, only to learn it’s not?

Watch the FULL video here: https://youtu.be/H0SE-_unHQ0

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4sEfThv

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.

It happens more often than you’d think.

Take fruit juice, for example.

It’s marketed as a healthy choice, but it’s actually far from healthy.

When you remove the fiber from fruit, you’re essentially left with concentrated liquid sugar, primarily fructose.

Consuming fructose can put a lot of stress on your liver.

Then there are seed oils.

They’re often labeled as “heart-healthy,” but are highly processed, genetically modified, and typically contain herbicides.

Oat milk is another example.

While it’s marketed as a great dairy alternative, it’s essentially a hidden sugar that can spike blood sugar levels.

Agave nectar, despite its natural origin, is incredibly high in fructose.

And kombucha, if not chosen carefully, can contain a surprising amount of added sugar.

Even some protein powders and other starchy foods can contain hidden ingredients like maltodextrin that act like sugar in the body.

It’s shocking how many foods that seem “healthy” on the surface can have negative effects on your metabolism.

Knowing the truth can make a huge difference in how you approach your well-being.

But it can be difficult to sift through all the information out there to find what truly matters for YOU.

Especially when trying to identify the one thing that could have the biggest impact on your health right now…

videos.title: Rory McIlroy's RECORD round of 62 | 2026 Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship
videos.summary_source_text:
Rory McIlroy's RECORD round of 62 | 2026 Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship Every broadcasted shot of Rory McIlroy's record round of 62 on Friday at the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship, which included 11 birdies. 

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

After 40 events, five global swings, the Back 9 and four Majors, the DP World Tour Play-Offs are upon us. The top 70 available players from the Race to Dubai Rankings Delivered by DP World tee it up this week at Yas Links before the top 50 then move on to the season-finale at the DP World Tour Championship. Both those events form part of the Rolex Series, with Patrick Reed, Tom Kim and JJ Spaun having already been crowned Rolex Series champions in 2026. With full playing privileges on the DP World Tour now secured the focus turns to the quest to be Europe’s Number One and claim the Harry Vardon Trophy. Rory McIlroy is looking to equal Colin Montgomerie's record of eight season-long wins with his fifth in a row but the Northern Irishman is in the unusual position of being the hunter rather than the hunted. Last year, Aaron Rai beat fellow Englishman Tommy Fleetwood in a play-off to win his second Rolex Series title at Yas Links, five years on from his first at the Scottish Open. The 70 player field is stacked with star-studded names, featuring 6 major winners including Rory McIlroy, Jon Rahm and Patrick Reed alongside three-time season winner Eugenio Chacarra who will be hoping to add a Rolex Series title to his CV. With enhanced points on offer it also means that the jostling for dual membership with the PGA Tour is far from over.

videos.title: 09.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
09.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger. RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger.

videos.title: Hindi - 09.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 09.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

Do Peptides ACTUALLY Work? Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as signals, telling your body to carry out specific functions. From GLP-1 medications to collagen peptides and BPC-157, different peptides serve different purposes, including appetite regulation, tissue repair, and joint support.

Watch the FULL video here: https://youtu.be/qovnfjVd8cs

🌟 Take Dr. Berg’s New Health Quiz—60 seconds is all it takes: https://drbrg.co/4BTuSZ0

But understanding peptide safety is just as important as understanding how they work. Many peptides are sourced overseas, and independent testing has raised concerns about incorrect amino acid sequences and product quality.

If you’re considering peptides, proper sourcing matters. A prescription from a licensed clinician who reviews your health history and lab results, along with a reputable pharmacy that provides product verification is essential.

videos.summary_source_text:
How to Reduce Visceral Fat and Shrink Your Waist | Dr. Mandell Visceral fat is not just belly fat—it is a metabolically active fat that surrounds your internal organs, including your liver and intestines, and can silently increase your risk of insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, fatty liver disease, chronic inflammation, and cardiovascular disease. Unlike the fat directly beneath your skin, excessive visceral fat can release inflammatory chemicals, including interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), while sending fatty acids toward the liver and interfering with healthy metabolic function. In this important video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains the science behind dangerous visceral fat and shares practical, research-supported strategies to help reduce it naturally, shrink your waistline, improve insulin sensitivity, and support long-term metabolic health. Discover why eliminating sugary beverages, eating more fiber-rich vegetables and quality protein, controlling portions, walking regularly, and building muscle through resistance training can make a meaningful difference. Learn how aerobic exercise and strength training work together to help reduce abdominal fat, why you cannot spot-reduce belly fat, and how simple daily changes can help protect your heart, liver, blood vessels, and overall health. 

Published research indexed in PubMed supports these important connections, including studies on visceral fat inflammation and insulin resistance (PMID: 30549014, 35953124), a six-month randomized trial examining sugary beverages and visceral fat accumulation (PMID: 22205311), a systematic review of 84 randomized controlled trials investigating exercise and visceral fat reduction (PMID: 38031812), and research demonstrating the benefits of resistance training for reducing visceral fat (PMID: 34536199). 

Remember, reducing visceral fat is about much more than looking slimmer—it's about improving your metabolic health, reducing excess inflammatory activity, and protecting your body from the inside out. Small, consistent changes can lead to meaningful improvements over time. Wishing you good health and continued healing. Dr. Mandell

videos.summary_source_text:
Jenny Cavnar on What the Rockies Need to Change | After the Horn What will it take to turn the Colorado Rockies into a competitive baseball team?

Former Rockies broadcaster Jenny Cavnar joins Tom Green and Woody Paige on After the Horn to discuss the changes needed to rebuild the organization.

Cavnar believes the process starts with leadership and establishing a winning culture. Drawing from her experience covering the Milwaukee Brewers and getting to know manager Pat Murphy, she explains why bringing in people with experience from successful organizations is an important first step.

She also discusses the Rockies' longstanding culture of loyalty and why looking outside the organization for new perspectives could help move the franchise forward.

Presented by @RedBirdFarmsChicken.

videos.summary_source_text:
GPT-6 Cyber: OpenAI's New AI Found 81 Hidden Firefox Security Flaws Try Unlimited Seedance 2.5 on OpenArt: https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=infl-youtube--na-acq-web&ref=BitBiasedAI-sd25

OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber reportedly generated **948 working Linux kernel exploits in just ten days**, discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities, and scored 48.5% on ExploitGym. The estimated cost? Around **$1,280 per working exploit**.

Those numbers suggest a major shift in AI-powered cybersecurity. But there's a catch: the headline benchmarks, the actual capabilities, and what independent researchers can verify tell three different stories.

OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber on November 5 as a specialized cybersecurity variant of GPT-6 Astra, designed to discover vulnerabilities, reproduce security flaws, develop working exploits, and help researchers test defenses. Unlike ordinary ChatGPT models, GPT-6 Cyber is restricted to vetted customers through OpenAI's Daybreak Red program, with identity verification, hardware security keys, and additional access controls.

The Linux experiment is particularly revealing. According to OpenAI, a multi-agent pipeline scanned approximately 5,000 security-relevant locations in the Linux kernel, identified 2,308 candidate crashes, confirmed 1,724 bugs, and produced 948 working exploits. OpenAI reports that 588 of those exploits targeted previously unknown vulnerabilities.

The entire experiment reportedly consumed $1,213,430 in API credits. Compared with traditional vulnerability research and exploit-development costs, that raises an uncomfortable question: **What happens when discovering serious software vulnerabilities becomes dramatically cheaper than fixing them?**

Then there's Firefox.

OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber identified 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and supplied reproducible evidence to Mozilla. Firefox 159's security advisory provides evidence of substantial security fixes, but the public record doesn't independently connect all 81 reported discoveries to GPT-6 Cyber.

The comparison with Anthropic is also important. Mozilla previously reported protections for 271 vulnerabilities discovered with Anthropic's Mythos Preview. Different testing conditions and counting methods make direct comparisons difficult, but the broader trend is unmistakable: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery is creating an enormous new workload for software maintainers.

And the benchmark story gets even more interesting.

However, the general-purpose GPT-6 Astra reportedly achieved 42.4% without the same cyber specialization. That makes the additional improvement from cyber-specific training considerably smaller than the headline comparison suggests.

Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is another serious competitor, with an independently unverified leaderboard listing it at 53.5% on ExploitGym. Meanwhile, OpenAI's general-purpose model with safeguards enabled scored zero on certain exploit tasks because it refused to perform them. That's an important distinction between lacking technical capability and being restricted from using it.

OpenAI has also classified GPT-6 Cyber as **Critical** under its cybersecurity Preparedness Framework. Its reported honeypot evaluations show a dramatic reduction in unauthorized, out-of-scope actions compared with GPT-5.6 Cyber. But even a small failure rate becomes significant when automated systems operate at scale.

We also examine OpenAI's reported Dragos power-grid security experiment, the $1 billion Daybreak initiative, and the growing competition between OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic to develop powerful cybersecurity AI while restricting potentially dangerous capabilities.

The bigger question isn't simply whether GPT-6 Cyber is better at hacking.

It's whether defenders can patch vulnerabilities quickly enough when AI systems can discover them at unprecedented scale, and what happens when similar capabilities become available outside tightly controlled programs.

This breakdown separates OpenAI's reported results from independently verifiable evidence, examines the limitations behind the benchmarks, and explores what GPT-6 Cyber could mean for cybersecurity researchers, open-source maintainers, businesses, and the future of AI-powered security.
